name: diamond_mixed_share_rename.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations (a Ref)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D1 (mk-D1 (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((D2 (mk-D2 (y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((C (mk-C (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((B (mk-B (x Int)(y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((A (mk-A (x Int)(by Int)(cy Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (sel-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations))
  (lift-D1 (sel-D1 D1))
  (lift-D2 (sel-D2 D2))
  (lift-C (sel-C C))
  (lift-B (sel-B B))
  (lift-A (sel-A A))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) TopLevelDeclarations
  (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D1 ((this Ref)) D1
  (sel-D1 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-D2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-D2 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-D2 ((this Ref)) D2
  (sel-D2 (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-C ((this Ref)) C
  (sel-C (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-B ((this Ref)) B
  (sel-B (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-A (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-A ((this Ref)) A
  (sel-A (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-TopLevelDeclarations ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-TopLevelDeclarations this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-D1 this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-A this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-D2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-D2 this)
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-A this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-C ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-C this)
    (deref-is-A this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-B ((this Ref)) Bool
  (or
    (deref-is-B this)
    (deref-is-A this)
  )
)

(define-fun deref-isa-A ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-A this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; -------------------------------------------
;   Getters for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; -------------------------------------------

; --- getters for TopLevelDeclarations.a: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations!a ((this Ref)) Ref
  (a (deref-TopLevelDeclarations this))
)

; ------------------------
;   Getters for class A:
; ------------------------

; --- getters for A.x: ---

(define-fun A.x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-A this))
)

; --- getters for A.by: ---

(define-fun A.by ((this Ref)) Int
  (by (deref-A this))
)

; --- getters for A.cy: ---

(define-fun A.cy ((this Ref)) Int
  (cy (deref-A this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ---------------------------------------------
;   Invariant for class TopLevelDeclarations:
; ---------------------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-0-TopLevelDeclarations TopLevelDeclarations)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-isa-A (TopLevelDeclarations!a this))
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv1 0) :named _xkassert0))

; --- Invariant 2: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A.x (TopLevelDeclarations!a this)) 10)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv2 0) :named _xkassert1))

; --- Invariant 3: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A.by (TopLevelDeclarations!a this)) 20)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv3 0) :named _xkassert2))

; --- Invariant 4: ---

(define-fun TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (A.cy (TopLevelDeclarations!a this)) 30)
)

(assert (! (TopLevelDeclarations.inv4 0) :named _xkassert3))



; ---------------------------
;   Invariant for class D1:
; ---------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-D1 D1)



; ---------------------------
;   Invariant for class D2:
; ---------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-D2 D2)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class C:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-5-C C)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class B:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-4-B B)



; --------------------------
;   Invariant for class A:
; --------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-A A)




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store(store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        0 (lift-TopLevelDeclarations const-0-TopLevelDeclarations))
        3 (lift-D1 const-3-D1))
        1 (lift-D2 const-1-D2))
        5 (lift-C const-5-C))
        4 (lift-B const-4-B))
        2 (lift-A const-2-A))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-3-D1 () D1
  (mk-D1 12))
(define-fun const-2-A () A
  (mk-A 10 20 30))
(define-fun const-4-B () B
  (mk-B 6 7))
(define-fun const-5-C () C
  (mk-C 8 9))
(define-fun const-1-D2 () D2
  (mk-D2 11))
(define-fun const-0-TopLevelDeclarations () TopLevelDeclarations
  (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2))
(define-fun _xkassert2 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (by (sel-A a!1)) 20)))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (is-lift-A a!1)))
(define-fun _xkassert3 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (cy (sel-A a!1)) 30)))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (let ((a!1 (select heap (a (sel-TopLevelDeclarations (select heap 0))))))
  (= (x (sel-A a!1)) 10)))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         0
                         (lift-TopLevelDeclarations (mk-TopLevelDeclarations 2)))
                  3
                  (lift-D1 (mk-D1 12)))))
(let ((a!2 (store (store a!1 1 (lift-D2 (mk-D2 11))) 5 (lift-C (mk-C 8 9)))))
  (store (store a!2 4 (lift-B (mk-B 6 7))) 2 (lift-A (mk-A 10 20 30))))))
